snippet.textDisplay: This game i had extremely high expectations for and being so serious it exceeded them for me , i underestimated too how much content their is in it and also underestimated the sheer depth and detail of everything and of the content. the games actual loop of open world and its transition to main story as well is absolutely amazing and it makes the entire game experience itself feel part of the main quest level of quality to me personally. But the depth you can get from just simple gameplay like robbing little stores or pawn shops etc anything. To stealing cars to escaping police this game had insane amount of mechanical improvements to core GTA gameplay loop. Then you get the things that dont hurt a game even open if theyre not present but if you put enough of them into a game they really do so much to positively impact the games world. I had a moment in the game on a dark road and I turned on manually my high beams. I noticed not only do NPC cars on darker roads turn on high beams too but they also turn them off when coming near opposite drivers too. And not only that but they also flash their high beams if you happen to keep yours on as they drive by you. It blew my mind that something so unnecessary and essentially useless to put into a game can be put in such an expansive game and it just makes it feel so alive and immersive that type of dedication kinda went into almost every aspect of this game. The gun play is way better the driving is better than i thought it would be. the routines and the way you can just live around in this game is special. The story on top of this i personally enjoy more than 5 , and even more so its side characters are vastly better than 5 in my opinion. Not to mention i was shocked by the actual graphics and tech of the game I expected it to be a good bit better look of rdr2 but it only has the style of their engine that Rdr2 has. Its a massive leap technology wise
